messages:
Nina (Partnerships): StratusCloud sent their marketplace tile + a two-page joint solution brief. They want an "Optimized for Redwood" badge with our full lockup inside it and to pull a short quote from Ethan for the one-pager. Need quick design + legal check before I reply. Links: /drive/StratusCloud/Stratus-Redwood-solution-brief-v2.pdf and thumb_preview.png. Timeline: they want to go live next Friday.

Priya (Design): opening files. immediate issues: full lockup inside a circular badge will compress our wordmark at small sizes. propose we only allow the monogram for badge use. Also the badge background uses a noisy gradient that creates banding at 72dpi; request a flat color or a higher-quality flattened export for thumbnails. Provide `redwood-monogram-white.svg` for dark backgrounds.

Ethan (CTO): about the quote, they pulled: "Redwood reduced inference latency by 60% in our fleet." that's accurate on median p95 during our pilot. fine to publish, but happy to review exact phrasing. can legal confirm if a technical metric needs attestation?

Sam (Legal): metrics need confirmation from the account owner or analytics lead in writing. for quotes, we require written approval from Ethan for any edited text. draft quote license: single paragraph granting limited, revocable usage for the assets and duration specified. also require StratusCloud to include our trademark notice and link to brand guidelines in the PDF footer.

BrandBot: suggested alt text: `StratusCloud and Redwood logos side-by-side with headline: Low-latency inference powered by Redwood` :white_check_mark:

Priya (Design): checklist to send StratusCloud as one consolidated list:
1) use `redwood-monogram-white.svg` for badge thumbnail (or provide 128x128 PNG with 16px safe padding)
2) provide 300dpi PDF export for print and a separate 72dpi flattened PNG sized 144x144 for marketplace
3) remove small legal text from the social-sized export; provide a clean social tile at 1200x628 and a square 1200x1200 for IG
4) move numeric claim and quote to the body so header stays logo-only

Nina (Partnerships): Sam, can you paste the one-paragraph license here so I can include it in the reply? Also Ethan, please confirm the metric attestation source (who signs off). I'll draft a single email with Priya's asset asks + license + attestation request.

Sam (Legal): pasteable draft: "By this license Redwood Inference grants StratusCloud a limited, non-exclusive, revocable right to reproduce the expressly approved quote attributed to Ethan [last name], CTO, solely in connection with the attached co-branded solution brief and StratusCloud's marketplace listing. The license is limited to the assets, channels, and timeframe specified in writing. Redwood reserves the right to require removal of the quote if used outside the agreed context or if materially altered without written approval."

Ethan (CTO): I'll ask Priya to pull the pilot metric report and Raj (AM) will confirm. If account confirms, I'm fine with exact number. Otherwise swap to "significantly reduced latency."

MKT Bot: Ticket PARTNER-3182 created: "StratusCloud co-brand asset & quote approvals" assigned to Nina, Priya, Sam. Deliverables suggested: 300dpi one-pager PDF, 144x144 marketplace tile, 1200x628 social tile. Due: 2025-10-10.

Nina (Partnerships): thanks all. I'll send consolidated reply to StratusCloud including Priya's asset list, Sam's license paragraph, and a request for Raj to provide the metric attestation. Will update thread when they respond. :rocket:
